note: BH-7505: the least time between two snapshot publishes of one project's pool inputs (and the write-back apply that goes with each). A snapshot is a tar of the project's queue, pool state and flags, and the hub's CPU is what the placement frees. Keep it well under lane_snapshot.max_age_s (1200), which the machine enforces. Settings row `lane.fly-pool.pool_fly_publish_min_s`.
